name: Jody Kriss

summary.text: Jody Kriss was the Bayrock Group's director of finance from 2003 to 2007. In 2010 he sued Bayrock, its principals Tevfik Arif and Felix Sater, and related entities and professional firms in the Southern District of New York under the civil RICO statute, alleging the firm laundered money, evaded taxes and defrauded him of money he was owed, and that Arif and Sater concealed Sater's 1998 racketeering conviction from the Trump Organization. Bayrock denied the claims. In February 2018 the parties agreed in principle to settle on undisclosed terms.
